general.title: General
general.name: Workspace name
general.currencyWarning: Changing the currency does not convert existing amounts. Every amount keeps its number and is shown in the new currency.

members.title: Members
members.removeIntro: {{name}} loses access to this workspace. An Owner can invite them again.
members.demoteIntro: {{name}} can still read this workspace but can no longer edit it.

consequences.label: What happens to their records
consequences.shared: Their Self Analysis stops being shared with this workspace. Its comments are hidden but kept. If they become an Owner or Member again, they have to share it again.
consequences.assigned: Execution items assigned to them keep their name as plain text, and due-date notifications stop.
consequences.assignedViewer: Execution items assigned to them keep their name as plain text, and due-date notifications stop, because a Viewer cannot be an assignee.
consequences.names: Their name stays on the ideas, comments and history they wrote, marked (former member).
consequences.namesViewer: Their name stays on what they wrote without a (former member) mark, because they are still a member.
consequences.notifications: Notifications they received in this workspace are kept. Opening one shows "You no longer have access".
consequences.notificationsViewer: Their notifications are kept. Only notifications about comments on their Self Analysis show "You no longer have access" when opened.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.hint: An invitation link is valid for 7 days. Copying or resending a link creates a new one, and the previous link stops working.
invitations.linkCopied: Link copied. The previous link no longer works.

manualLink.heading: Copy this link yourself
manualLink.body: Your browser did not allow copying. Select the link below and copy it. The previous link no longer works.
manualLink.label: Invitation link

invitations.cancelBody: The link stops working. You can send a new invitation later.
